cache_policy: Original third-party PDFs and complete extracted text remain outside Git under /workspace/work/reference. This file stores only short supporting excerpts and fingerprints.

sources.short_quote: DPO uses a change of variables to define the preference loss as a function of the policy directly.
sources.inspection_note: Read the same-prompt preferred/dispreferred setup, reward-model loss, KL-regularized objective, Eq. (7), and pipeline. This supports direct policy optimization as an alternative to the explicit reward-model/RL pipeline, without a universal quality claim.

sources.short_quote: Most techniques for computing variance-reduced advantage-function estimators make use a learned state-value function V (s).
sources.inspection_note: Read advantages, old/new policy probability ratio, clipped surrogate, value-loss combination and sample/update algorithm. A learned reward model is not required by general PPO; it belongs to this chapter’s preference-feedback route.

sources.short_quote: Because the reward model is an imperfect proxy, optimizing its value too much can hinder ground truth performance.
sources.inspection_note: Read the proxy-vs-gold construction and empirical overoptimization description. The paper’s gold ground truth is itself a 6B reward model in a synthetic setup, not an objective theorem of answer correctness. Used only to support the need to separately verify task performance.

sources.short_quote: with the most challenging questions, we observe very little benefits from scaling up test-time compute.
sources.inspection_note: Read the proposal/verifier framework, prompt-difficulty-dependent effects and need for capability-specific fine-tuning. Additional test-time work is not a certificate that an individual answer is correct; no reported performance or scaling factor is transferred to Tiny Perceptron.
